blocks.tamil_translation: “When you set out on a journey, be sure to travel for a while at night as well, because at night the earth is folded up,” Hazrat Anas (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- Once you have left home for a journey, do not be content with travelling only by day; travel for some time at night as well. For at night there are not the obstacles there are by day, and so the journey is completed easily. This is the meaning conveyed by the words “the earth is folded up”.
(Mazahir-e-Haq)

blocks.narrator: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-As (RA)
blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ ﵄ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: اَلرَّاكِبُ شَيْطَانٌ وَالرَّاكِبَانِ شَيْطَانَانِ وَالثَّلَاثَةُ رَكْبٌ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث عبد الله بن عمرو احسن، باب ما جاء في كراهية ان يسافر وحده، رقم: ١٦٧٤
blocks.tamil_translation: “One traveller is a shaytan, two travellers are two shaytans, three travellers are a Jama'ah,” Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-As (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- The meaning of “rider” mentioned in the blessed hadith is a traveller. If one or two people travel alone, Shaytan can easily lead them astray. To make this clear, those travelling alone or in twos were called shaytan. Therefore, it is necessary that there be at least three people on a journey. By this they will be protected from Shaytan. Moreover, they will be of help to one another in praying in congregation (Jama'ah) and in other matters; this is the meaning of this hadith.
(Mazahir-e-Haq)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: اَلشَّيْطَانُ يَهُمُّ بِالْوَاحِدِ وَاْلاِثْنَيْنِ فَإِذَا كَانُوا ثَلَاثَةً لَمْ يَهُمَّ بِهِمْ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البزار وفيه عبد الرحمن بن ابي الزناد وهو ضعيف وقد وثق، مجمع الزوائد: ٣ /٤٩١
